# Skill directory listings — paste-ready copy

The [skills.sh listing](https://www.skills.sh/kayforkind/reimagine-it) is
generated from `skills/reimagine-it/SKILL.md`, so it is always current.
The directories below take manual submissions from the owner; use this copy
verbatim. Keep it in sync when tokens or install paths change — the CI
version-sync guard catches stale `version:` fields in this repo, not here.

Last verified against the engine: **v2.13.0**, 17 tokens, CLI-first.

- **URL:** https://www.skills.sh/kayforkind/reimagine-it

## cursor.directory

**Title:** reimagine-it — Content-Derived Design

**Description:**

> Reads existing HTML and writes a stronger standalone page from the facts,
> names, dates, numbers, emails, and hex colors already in the file.
> 17 design tokens (webpage, infographic, svg, 3js, simulation, artistic,
> cinematic, dashboard, photography, landing, editorial, gradient, showcase,
> motion, glass, lookbook, particles) plus Auto, which scores every lane
> against the content and picks the strongest. The agent runs the CLI
> (`npx reimagine-it --auto -i page.html -o out.html`); it does not
> hand-author the page. Offline, deterministic, no API key. HTML in,
> HTML out — no PDF/PPTX/DOCX ingestion.

**Install:** `npx skills add Kayforkind/reimagine-it`
**Repo:** https://github.com/Kayforkind/reimagine-it

## ClawHub

**Name:** reimagine-it

**Summary:**

> Content-Derived Design for agent hosts. Extract, redesign, audit:
> `npx reimagine-it extract|variations|lock|audit`. Auto evaluates up to
> three directions and ships the strongest, with a fidelity report proving
> every source fact survived. 19-rule Design Health audit with zero-incident
> gating. MCP server included: `npx reimagine-it mcp` (8 tools).

**Tags:** design, html, css, frontend, infographic, threejs, accessibility, offline
**Install:** `npx skills add Kayforkind/reimagine-it`
